description: Sync customers, products, carts and orders with Mailchimp
name: Mailchimp

highlights.title: Abandoned-cart emails that work
highlights.description: Carts sync with a link back to checkout and are removed once they become orders, so nobody is reminded about a purchase.

highlights.title: Order emails and purchase history
highlights.description: Orders sync with items, totals, discounts and status, powering order emails, purchase segments and each contact's order history.

highlights.title: Unsubscribes stay in step
highlights.description: Unsubscribes, bounces and email changes made in Mailchimp flow back to Swell, so you never market to someone who opted out.

highlights.title: Products in every email
highlights.description: Products and variants sync with prices, stock, images and links for Mailchimp's product blocks and recommendations.

highlights.title: A first sync that emails no one
highlights.description: Existing customers, products and orders are sent in bulk with automations paused, so no one hears about old orders.

images.title: Mailchimp for Swell
images.description: Customers, products, carts and orders stay in sync with Mailchimp, and unsubscribes come back to Swell.

images.title: Two-way sync
images.description: Store data goes to Mailchimp as it changes, and unsubscribes, bounces and email changes made in Mailchimp come back.

images.title: Choose exactly what syncs
images.description: Turn customers, products, carts and orders on or off, pick which carts count, and decide how opt-ins are handled.

images.title: Mailchimp's ecommerce features, on
images.description: Abandoned-cart emails, order notifications, product recommendations, purchase segments and order history.
